title: Keep one-time browser test preparation out of case budgets

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Caught

Revision checked: a47cbf7f78ea5b9b2ce0d760e1b24592422e7675, in an isolated scratch worktree. Invocation start 2026-11-17T23:27:46Z; elapsed 270091 ms (measured by finish-report.mjs).

Promise checked: one-time preparation of both hosts' queued origins happens in worker fixtures, outside each first case's 30 s budget.

Fault: in dashboard/tests/support/preparationPage.ts, removed the `origin` fixture's dependency on `queuedOriginsReady` and its `await Promise.resolve(queuedOriginsReady)`. As a result, `startOrigin` requests the queued artifact inside the case.

Catching assertion: dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/test-preparation-budget.spec.ts:30, in all three runner variants (Integrated, Backend, E2E). It waits in `Promise.race([reached, run.result])` for both layouts to be held before any case reports. With the fault, the two layouts were never requested together, and all three tests timed out at 30000 ms. Limit: the catch is a timeout at that gate, not a named expect message.

Commands (focused command with the strict reporter; load = vm.loadavg):
- Baseline: exit 0, 3 of 3 passed; load 6.03 → 8.29.
- Faulted: exit 1, 3 of 3 timed out at 30002–30003 ms; load 8.18 → 5.23.
- Restored: exit 0, 3 of 3 passed; load 5.97 → 5.69.

Independent witness (temporary spec, deleted afterwards): an ungated nested run of preparation.proof.ts recording the artifact trace and fixture steps.
- Fault: start-origin-claude-queued was built at 1697–2484 ms, inside the Claude case's `origin` step (1690–2680). start-origin-codex-queued was built at 3309–4015, inside the Codex case's `origin` step (3307–4122).
- Restored: both bases were prepared inside the worker fixture `queuedOriginsReady` (1352–2305), which has its own 60 s timeout. The case's `origin` step took 78 ms.

Restoration: preparationPage.ts was copied back; `cmp` against HEAD showed it identical, `git status` was clean, and the restored run passed. The scratch worktree was removed.

Not probed: a plain `{scope:"worker"}` fault on `queuedOriginsReady`, app-build and server-bundle preparation, and natural (non-burner) load.

Next proof action: none needed for the queued-origin path.

Wrap-up disposition: a47cbf7f78ea5b9b2ce0d760e1b24592422e7675, Caught, no follow-up.
